modelReview.summary: The analysis is an ungoverned exploratory logistic regression that lacks variable definitions, cohort flow, and separation diagnostics; p-values are presented without pre-specification and are thus invalid for inference. The study is not ready for any clinical or public-health claim.

findings.title: Analysis is ungoverned exploratory and lacks pre-specified protocol
findings.whyItMatters: Without a pre-registered protocol, p-values and confidence intervals are not controlled for multiplicity and have no confirmatory value; any claim of association is hypothesis-generating at best.
findings.actionableFix: Either pre-register a full analysis plan and re-run the analysis under that governance, or clearly label results as exploratory and remove p-values and confidence intervals, providing only descriptive summaries and effect sizes with no assertion of 'significance'.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check for existence of bound analysisSpec or methodSelection artifacts; they are null.

findings.title: Variable definitions, units, and coding are absent
findings.whyItMatters: Interpretation of odds ratios is impossible without knowing what outcome_binary=1 means, how treatment is coded, what severity and albumin measure and their units.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a comprehensive codebook: define each variable, its possible values, units, and any transformations. Include this in the manuscript or a supplementary artifact.
findings.deterministicVerification: Search for variable definitions in manuscript or companion artifact; none found.

findings.title: Cohort assembly and missingness process not described
findings.whyItMatters: Selection bias from missing data or eligibility criteria can distort associations; without reporting the flow from source to analytic sample, risk of bias is unclear.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number of observations excluded at each step, reasons for missingness, and compare characteristics of included vs excluded subjects. Conduct sensitivity analysis for missing data (e.g., multiple imputation if applicable).
findings.deterministicVerification: No cohort flow diagram or missingness table in artifacts.

findings.title: Model diagnostics are insufficient and partly inappropriate
findings.whyItMatters: Logistic regression residuals are not normally distributed; Shapiro-Wilk test is meaningless. Also, no separation check (e.g., Firth's bias correction, profile likelihood confidence intervals) is reported, which is critical for sparse outcomes or small samples. Cook's distance max 0.045 is noted but not interpreted.
findings.actionableFix: Remove Shapiro-Wilk test. Report a separation diagnostic (e.g., check for complete or quasi-separation using the R separatedetect package or similar). If separation is possible, use Firth penalized logistic regression. For influence, highlight any observations with Cook's distance > 0.5 or leverage > 2p/n.
findings.deterministicVerification: Shapiro p-value present in diagnostics; no separation diagnostic field.

findings.title: Causal language used without causal framework
findings.whyItMatters: Phrases like 'treatment associated ... after adjustment' imply a causal interpretation, but no DAG or confounder selection rationale is provided. Observational studies require explicit causal assumptions and sensitivity analyses to move beyond association.
findings.actionableFix: Either adopt causal language strictly, e.g., 'estimated association', or provide a DAG and justify covariate selection. Include a sensitivity analysis for unmeasured confounding (e.g., E-value).
findings.deterministicVerification: No causal diagram or confounder selection justification found.

findings.title: Outcome prevalence not reported
findings.whyItMatters: Without outcome prevalence, the intercept odds and baseline risk are not interpretable. This also affects evaluation of model calibration.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number and proportion of outcome=1 in the cohort.

findings.title: Manuscript self-referentially claims no reader-facing paper artifact
findings.whyItMatters: The limitation 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' is confusing given that this manuscript is that artifact; it appears to be a template leftover. This reduces clarity.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or clarify this line; if it refers to an external reader-facing report, specify that.

findings.title: No raw data or data dictionary provided
findings.whyItMatters: Full reproducibility requires access to de-identified data or at least summary statistics. The manuscript mentions artifact inventory but does not include a public data statement.
findings.actionableFix: If data cannot be shared, provide a detailed data dictionary and summary statistics of all variables. Specify access conditions.
findings.deterministicVerification: No data file or data dictionary artifact in provided list.
